نخترق (form VIII)

# نُخْتَرَقُ (nuḵtaraqu) /nux.ta.ra.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# نَخْتَرِقَ (naḵtariqa) /nax.ta.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# نُخْتَرَقَ (nuḵtaraqa) /nux.ta.ra.qa/:
